query: Please implement a blockchain multichain DApp for cryptocurrency trading. The DApp should have a user-friendly interface, making it easy for cryptocurrency traders to use. Users should be able to log in, browse and manage their cryptocurrency assets, conduct transactions, view market trends, and utilize DeFi functionalities. The DApp should provide real-time market data and trading information, ensuring users can make informed trading decisions. Set overall background to azure, then style components with slate blue.
